subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw accept `session.restartContinuation` as the opt-in contract for preserving aborted main-session ids across controlled Gateway restarts?
rationale: The source-level gap is real enough to keep tracking, but the proposed repair adds a compatibility-sensitive session config surface and changes session-state reuse semantics.

options.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in
options.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers accept an explicit config knob for this narrow Gateway restart continuity case.

options.title: Require config-free recovery
options.body: Keep the issue open but redirect the fix toward a broader restart-recovery mechanism that avoids another session config option.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR if maintainers decide OpenClaw should not preserve aborted session ids across restarts for this workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the linked opt-in
recommendation.body: Proceed with reviewing and landing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers accept an explicit config knob for this narrow Gateway restart continuity case.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the terminal-main transcript reconciliation behavior being modified and have adjacent current-main history in the same Gateway/session area.
